title: Replacement members of the remedy rules of one policy version
description: Members added by feature 003 to the `remedies` front-matter block (specs/002-remedy-repair-handover/contracts/remedy-rules.schema.json). The first 003 domain task merges these two properties into that schema's `properties` (research R1). Read only by the deterministic RemedyPolicyEvaluator and ReplacementPolicy. Both members are optional; without `replacement` the defaults SameModel, AtCollection and 0 apply; without `replacementNotAvailable` the remedy goes to manual review (002 FR-012).

replacement.description: How a Replacement remedy is carried out (FR-001 to FR-003).

productRule.description: SameCategoryAtLeastClaimValue: another model of the same product category whose claim value is at least the original's, approved by a reviewer (FR-002, FR-024).

returnRule.description: When the faulty product must be returned (FR-003).

minimumCoverMonths.description: A replacement unit is covered until the later of the original coverage end and the hand-over date plus these months (FR-029).

replacementNotAvailable.description: Remedy when no allowed replacement is available (FR-004, FR-026). Same shape as the 002 rows: exactly one of `remedy` or `allowed`.
